mapper.sql: select id, import_batch_no, patient_name, id_card, data_category, data_json, create_by, create_time from biz_his_bigdata
mapper.insert: insert ignore into biz_his_bigdata (import_batch_no, patient_name, id_card, data_category, data_json, create_by, create_time) values (#{item.importBatchNo}, #{item.patientName}, #{item.idCard}, #{item.dataCategory}, #{item.dataJson}, #{item.createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select data_json from biz_his_bigdata where patient_name = #{patientName} and id_card = #{idCard} order by id desc limit 1
